C1381.title: U.S. DOJ Dismantles IoT Botnet Spanning 3 Million Devices
C1381.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice disrupted multiple botnets involving about 3 million IoT devices, which were used to launch record 31.4 Tbps DDoS attacks. Attackers hijacked large numbers of IoT devices to form botnets and launch large-scale distributed denial-of-service attacks against target services. The incident reflects internet infrastructure risks from weak passwords, exposed management interfaces, and delayed device patching.
